name: wasm-image-lab
description: Differential-benchmark harness: Rust/WASM image kernels vs a JS reference implementation.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p web/pkg && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wasm.wasm web/pkg/image_kernels.wasm
scripts.bench: npm run build:wasm && npm run serve
